positions.title: GTM | Strategy & Operations Lead
positions.description:
• Leads Go-To-Market Strategy & Operations for YouTube Ads monetization across EMEA strengthening YouTube’s position as an unparallel platform for advertisers & delivering significant revenue growth for Alphabet
• Acts as the main strategy & operations lead partnering with a cross-functional group of product, sales and marketing teams to drive annual planning, senior executive reviews and decision making, in addition to designing & building reporting capabilities and surfacing key insights to influence YouTube’s global roadmap and underpin its rapid growth
• Co-leads strategic initiatives incl. the design, launch & execution of regular sales performance reviews via a rigorous sales pipeline process across Google globally and rewards & recognition programs for thousands of sellers

positions.title: Co-Founder & Ambassador
positions.description:
• Bootstrapped Mentorink, an online mentoring platform which enables companies to accelerate the development of their employees through meaningful social connections
• Led product development from scratch to product market fit and into an award-winning planform
• Built the business model & a strong team, that is now scaling Mentorink as a B2B SaaS for HR teams globally 
• As a passionate believer in its potential, works to promote mentoring to transform many more individuals and workplaces around the world

positions.title: Analytical Consultant
positions.description:
• Worked in the Analytics & Insights team for large advertisers in the UK, specifically looking after Retail and Apparel clients
• Provided clients with insights and recommendations to help them build a solid marketing strategy and capture opportunities in the market 
• Conducted data analysis and generated insights about the market, consumer behavior and competitive landscape by marrying Google’s various data sources with 3rd party sources

positions.title: Strategy Manager
positions.description:
• Worked in the central consultancy team that provides O2 UK’s Board with recommendations on strategic decisions
• Conducted strategic market, technology and competition analysis across various business lines, and delivered future-proof strategic plans in the light of customer needs, trends and commercial targets
• Supported major divisions of the business on steering the development of future products and services by identifying the opportunities/threats, defining priorities and validating plans through building business cases

positions.title: Management Trainee
positions.description:
• Joined Telefonica's European Graduate Program as one of the 8 graduates in Germany and 46 in Europe
• Worked as a Product Manager leading the development of financial services products such as mobile wallet, online payments and device insurances
• Participated in the team that launched the very first “Usage-based Insurance – Telematics” product in Germany, being responsible for leading the setup of the M2M infrastructure of the product
• Completed a 6-month assignment at Telefónica Digital in London and worked on strategic analysis and planning projects supporting various business areas with a specific focus on Future Comms and Big Data

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Co-founded a start-up which developed an indoor positioning platform and delivered indoor location based services software for both web and mobile devices
• Led product, partnerships and distribution strategy development from scratch to commercial implementation stage
• Conducted the very first commercial implementation of an indoor location based services platform on a university campus in Istanbul
• Grew the company from the founding stage to $50K+ revenue a year with 6 employees
